courses.title: Doorways of the Heart: A Tibetan Yoga New Year Retreat
courses.description: A New Year retreat at Kripalu in which Dr. James Bae teaches Tibetan Buddhist yoga and meditation for times of loss and change. The six bardos of the Tibetan Book of the Dead serve as a map for moving through grief, alongside community ritual and daily Kripalu yoga classes.
